name: huly-mcp-selfhost
description: Work in Huly — issues, epics, documents, chat, inbox, planner — self-hosted or Huly Cloud.
long_description: Lets Claude work in your Huly workspaces: issues, epics, milestones, components, documents, chat, inbox, planner, calendar, test management and more. One-call overviews (my day, standup, project report, release notes), start/finish work with PR links, plans and meeting notes into issues, and undo for every change. Works with self-hosted Huly and Huly Cloud. Talks only to your Huly server — no telemetry.

huly_email.title: Huly e-mail
huly_email.description: Login e-mail of your Huly account. Google/GitHub login: leave empty and use a token.

huly_password.title: Huly password
huly_password.description: Password of the Huly account. Stored in your system keychain.

huly_token.title: Huly token (instead of e-mail/password)
huly_token.description: API token from Huly → Settings → API tokens, or from: npx huly-mcp-selfhost setup

huly_accounts_url.title: Accounts URL (self-hosted)
huly_accounts_url.description: e.g. https://huly.example.com/_accounts — leave empty for Huly Cloud

huly_front_url.title: Front URL (self-hosted)
huly_front_url.description: e.g. https://huly.example.com — needed for descriptions, documents and files

huly_workspace.title: Workspace (optional)
huly_workspace.description: Pin one workspace (slug or name): fewer tokens. Empty = all workspaces of the account

huly_toolsets.title: Toolsets (optional)
huly_toolsets.description: Comma-separated, e.g. tracker,documents,planner — or all. Empty = defaults

huly_write_projects.title: Writable projects (optional)
huly_write_projects.description: Only allow changes in these project keys, e.g. TSK,WEB. Empty = all

huly_file_root.title: Local file folder (optional)
huly_file_root.description: Drive uploads and downloads may use local paths inside this folder
